title: Intraluminal Imaging of Duodenal Layer Morphometry in Patients With and Without Type 2 Diabetes
brief_summary: This observational study is conducted to determine how the duodenal layer thicknesses (mucosa, submucosa, and muscularis) vary with several factors in patients with and without type 2 diabetes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient is already scheduled for upper endoscopy with ultrasound or OCT, such as those with Barrett's esophagus.
* Patient is willing to sign an informed consent form.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient is not a candidate for endoscopy, EUS, or OCT, such as those with strictures, inflammatory disease or previous anastomosis of the esophagus or duodenum.
study_population: Patients undergoing previously scheduled routine endoscopy of the upper gastrointestinal tract.
